_comment: vendor_spend.proto). Readers, each of which asserts its own table
each call's context and judges its cache outcome;
- the daemon (daemon/internal/vendorspend) does the same for its own
headless runs, validates every reported bucket, and publishes the
context_buckets_tokens are the inclusive upper bounds, ascending, of the
context-size buckets (a call's context is cache_read + cache_write +
uncached_input); a context above the last is above every bound.
cache_outcomes are cases of the one cache-outcome rule
cache_write (both tiers) and uncached_input, and the outcome the rule
gives it, named by the enum value's suffix.
